Q5787.reason: Firing a gun at a person shows malice (deadly-weapon intent to cause serious injury or depraved-heart recklessness), which supports murder of the person actually killed.

Q8553.reason: Alcoholic chronic pancreatitis with steatorrhea causes fat-soluble vitamin D malabsorption, producing severe hypocalcemia with tetany, Chvostek, and Trousseau signs.

Q5028.reason: A proposed school label in a brochure and recorded plat is not a deed covenant, equitable servitude, or completed public easement, so the designation is unenforceable.
